title: Sage Teal Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Palazzo Set
color_custom: Dusty sage teal with maroon & mustard flowers
description:
A Jaipur classic in a rare dusty sage-teal – hand block printed with big maroon and mustard-yellow florals and printed on soft, breathable cotton. Made in Jaipur by Bahe Kurtiz.

The kurta is a flowy A-line with a high halter neckline, a keyhole button opening at the back and a graceful calf-length flare that twirls beautifully. It comes with matching wide-leg palazzo pants in the same print for an easy, put-together look.

• Kurta: 100% cotton, hand block print, halter neck, sleeveless, back keyhole with button, A-line flare, calf length
• Palazzo: cotton, matching print, wide leg, elastic waist, ankle length
• Soft, breathable and comfortable all day
• Made to measure available – stitched to your exact measurements at no extra cost
• Perfect for Diwali, festive lunches, mehendi, office and summer evenings
• Style it with silver jhumkas and gold heels

Every hand block print has small variations – that is the beauty of handmade. Colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
set_items: A-line Halter Kurta (cotton, hand block print)
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
